analyze.description: Perform deep code analysis including dependencies, impact, and security

review.description: Perform comprehensive code review focusing on quality and maintainability

commit.description: Create a git commit following project standards and linking to kanban tasks

create-task.description: Create a new task with dependency analysis and automatic task splitting

review-task.description: Move task from ongoing to review with comprehensive code quality analysis

complete-task.description: Move task from review to done and create git commit

merge-to-uat.description: Merge dev branch into UAT for testing with validation checks
